messages:
Sunita: Quick follow-up from today's RFC — proposing a 'clean-room' extraction of the runtime control plane (routing, batching, health) into a new service 'runtime-orchestrator'. Goal: reduce coupling so model-serving can be iterated independently. Main tradeoffs below.
Mike: 👍 sounds useful. Concern: KV cache placement. If orchestrator controls batching, it needs access to token-level KV or at least cache hooks. That means cross-service latency.
Rafael: Agreed. If we move batching, we also move batching metrics. How do we keep per-model latency SLOs? We can't have orchestrator opaque to model pools.
Sunita: Good points. Thinking of two-phase approach: (1) extract control-plane APIs (route decision, batching policy) with lightweight grpc+proto contract, keep KV local to model nodes; (2) introduce optional remote cache later with explicit instrumentation.
Mike: proto sketch:
```
service RuntimeOrch {
  rpc DecideRoute(RouteRequest) returns (RouteDecision);
  rpc GetBatchPolicy(ModelId) returns (BatchPolicy);
}
```
Rafael: That looks fine. Also add `TraceContext` header so we can attribute latency to orchestrator vs runtime.
Olivia: Product note — any rollout must preserve canary behavior. Customers on Dedicated expect zero change to per-request ordering and cold-start profiles.
Sunita: We'll ship behind feature flag and add invariant tests. Plan: spike this quarter -> migrate one low-traffic model -> iterate. Who can own spike?
Mike: I can take the spike. Will need 2 wks + test harness. Blocking: current infra-sim doesn't support split control-plane, I'll add adapter shim.
Rafael: I'll help with dashboards and traces. Also let's document fallback: orchestrator failure -> direct routing by model nodes.
eng-bot: CI build triggered — link: https://ci.redwood.internal/1234 :white_check_mark:
Sunita: TL;DR: phased extraction, keep KV local, add explicit traces, preserve canaries and fallback. Recording notes in RFC thread. @mike assign? :memo:
Mike: assigned. PR incoming when spike done.
Olivia: Thanks — product ok as long as invariants hold.
Rafael: small nit: add a migration checklist: schema changes, metrics mapping, chaos tests.
Sunita: Will add checklist to RFC doc. Thanks all.
